data.name: Husaina
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Husn' which means 'goodness' or 'handsomeness'. The name Husaina signifies the lady of the sacred sanctuary, or the one who resides in a sacred place. In Islamic tradition, it is often associated with Imam Husain, the grandson of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and his sacrifice and devotion.
